# Master Makeup Studio & Academy

> India's premier Professional Beautician Course in Belagavi & Hubballi — 3-month, 15-module hands-on training with senior trainers, live-client studio, 95% placement.

## Overview
Master Makeup Studio & Academy is a 10-year-old vocational training institute exclusively training **professional beauticians**. Founded in 2015, the academy has trained 500+ beauticians across two centres in North Karnataka.

## Course
- **Name**: Professional Beautician Course
- **Duration**: 3 months (also 6–8 week fast-track)
- **Modules**: 15 — skin science, facials, threading, waxing, bleaching, de-tan, body therapies, manicure, pedicure, salon management
- **Format**: 70% practical · 30% theory · live-client sessions from week 3
- **Batch size**: max 12 students
- **Certification**: Professional Beautician Certificate (industry-recognised)
- **Placement**: 95% placement rate via 40+ partner salon network
